header: An intro that stays while the list scrolls
lead: One column stays in place while the other holds up to 12 entries. Use it on long feature pages, so readers always see what the list is about.

items.title: Sticky on medium and wide screens
items.text: On small screens the columns stack and nothing is pinned.

items.title: Stays below the site header
items.text: The offset is the header height plus a gap, so the first line is never hidden.

items.title: Reverse moves the intro
items.text: The columns swap sides. The order in the HTML stays the same.

items.title: Three to twelve entries
items.text: With fewer than three, there is nothing to scroll past the intro.

items.title: Entries can link
items.text: The whole row becomes clickable, as in the other feature elements.
